title: Resolve PR #36 against current main
summary: PR #36 now incorporates current main without dropping either line of work. The merged runtime keeps main's event-driven refresh, derived cache, agent-presence leases, and idle-CPU optimizations while retaining pull-request loading and review routes. Artifact rendering and the context-first PR UI coexist, derived UI assets were rebuilt from merged source, and eve history was rebuilt from all unioned records.
userVisibleChange: PR #36 is updated onto current main without losing main's UI or CPU optimizations. Pull-request review, artifact previews, runtime events, and current eve Snapshot context all remain available together.

risks.title: Large cross-stack merge
risks.mitigation: Full Go tests, 65 UI tests including runtime-event and artifact suites, production TypeScript/Vite build, npm tests, package dry-run, and two-axis staged review all passed.

decisions.title: Preserve all runtimeServer capabilities
decisions.rationale: The only manual source conflict in the runtime server struct was resolved by retaining the PR's pullRequestLoader alongside main's runtime events and agent lease owner.

decisions.title: Rebuild generated assets instead of merging bundles
decisions.rationale: Hashed UI bundles from both branches are derived output. Rebuilding from the combined TypeScript source guarantees the embedded UI contains both runtime-event and pull-request-review behavior.

decisions.title: Rebuild eve cache from unioned records
decisions.rationale: The cache index is derived from Snapshot files. Rebuilding it after retaining both branches' Plan and Snapshot records avoids selecting either stale cache copy.
